literal: The fate of loss will cause ignorance; the fate of gaining, when occurred, will expand knowledge.
translation: The destiny of loss makes one foolish, whereas the destiny of gain, when it arrives, expands one's wisdom.
modern: இழப்பைத் தரும் ஊழ்வினை ஒருவனை அறிவற்றவனாக ஆக்கும்; ஆக்கத்தைத் தரும் ஊழ்வினை வந்து சேரும்போது, அது அவனது அறிவை விரிவடையச் செய்யும்.
explanation: This couplet explains how destiny influences human intellect. When a person is destined to suffer loss, their mind is clouded by ignorance, leading them to make poor decisions. Conversely, when the destiny of prosperity and gain arrives, it naturally expands their wisdom, enabling them to think clearly and succeed. Thus, the power of destiny shapes even the sharpness of one's intellect.
